correctness.summary: Both multiplier identities are exact. Multiplication of z'''+a z''+b z'+c z=g(z) by z' gives integral(z'')^2=b integral(z')^2; multiplication by z'' and integration by parts gives integral[-g'(z)](z')^2=(ab-c)integral(z')^2. The invariant-measure extension follows independently from the generator applied to v^2/2, z^2/2, a primitive of g, vw, zv, g(z)v and w^2/2; the signs reproduce exactly the same slope constant. The strict slope-crossing corollary is valid because any interior level of a nonconstant periodic scalar trajectory is traversed with nonzero derivative on some monotone segment. For Goodwin, direct elimination gives (D+beta1)(D+beta2)(D+beta3)R=K f(R), and symbolic expansion verifies a1 a2-a3=(beta1+beta2)(beta1+beta3)(beta2+beta3). Routh-Hurwitz then gives the identical local Hopf slope threshold and frequency sqrt(a2).

independent_checks: Re-derived the periodic multiplier identities and the invariant-measure generator calculation.
Symbolically verified the Goodwin factorization a1*a2-a3=H.
Inspected the open full text of Hastings 1977 as a direct classical comparator.
limitations: The identities are necessary constraints and do not prove existence, uniqueness or stability of oscillations.
Strict slope crossing excludes the affine-critical-slope degeneracy on the full oscillation range.
The invariant-measure extension assumes compact support.
The exact Goodwin period relation is prior work; the novelty claim is only the weighted-slope law and consequences.

originality.summary: Forger's 2011 exact Goodwin period relation and its minimum-period consequence are prior art and are correctly excluded from the novelty claim. Chen--Shih 2026 supplies the local Hopf/stoichiometric analysis. A full open copy of Hastings 1977 was inspected; it proves existence/uniqueness/global orbital stability for a particular Goodwin system by comparison and Poincare-map methods, and does not state the present derivative-energy weighted feedback-slope identity. Searches likewise did not locate the invariant-measure version or the global slope-crossing consequence. The multiplier calculation is short, so older biochemical-control or third-order-ODE literature remains a residual attribution risk; novelty is accepted narrowly for the exact global slope identity and its Goodwin interpretation.

scientific_value.summary: The theorem turns the local Hurwitz/Hopf slope into an exact finite-amplitude constraint on every periodic orbit and every compact recurrent statistical state. The slope-crossing corollary gives a useful obstruction that can rule out proposed oscillations from feedback-shape information alone.
